epiSCANEER (McBASC co-evolution network + epistatic SCI), github.com/khsub87/epiSCANEER

Four, all in the homolog selection and none of them part of the published protocol: (1) homologs were taken from a UniProtKB download of Pfam family PF01630 and scored by pairwise local alignment instead of PSI-BLAST against UniRef90; (2) a >=70% query-coverage filter was added, which the paper does not have; (3) a <=90% mutual-identity filter between homologs was added, which the paper does not have; (4) selection stopped at a cap of 300 homologs after a seeded random shuffle, so the set is an arbitrary sample of 4810 candidates and a different seed gives a different set. The paper imposes no cap and no random sampling.
300 homologs, identity to query 32.6-89.7% (median 44.4%); 241 of the 300 fall in the 40-50% band. Only 20 sequences are shared with the 501-sequence run.
MUSCLE, ClustalW output, default parameters. 301 sequences (query + 300), 1146 columns. Input: input/PH20.aln
PDB 9JUB chain A (PH20 residues 37-442, deposited in P38567 numbering; verified residue-by-residue, 406/406 match)
928 residue pairs, from 1018 predicted pairs after removing pairs that touch a disulfide cysteine, an N-glycosylation site or the catalytic Glu148

SCI_norm, the min-max normalised epiSCI score. SCI_norm is an exactly linear transform of MUT_SCI, so the two give identical rankings. Structure distance and the region/flag columns are external annotations and do NOT enter the ranking.

MUT_SCI -0.39279 to 0.11190. The range is set by this run's own extremes, so SCI_norm values are NOT comparable with another run's. The paper's 0.86 threshold does not transfer: here the top 5% boundary is 0.8123.
P38567 = full-length precursor. mature / rHuPH20 = precursor position - 35, the numbering used in the rHuPH20 patent literature.
Top100 and Top50 are the head of the ranking. All holds the complete 928-pair shortlist.

Minimum heavy-atom distance from the residue to catalytic Glu148, in angstrom, measured on PDB 9JUB. Blank when the residue is outside the modelled 37-442 range.

Y when either residue lies within 10 A of Glu148. Those rows are shaded. NOTE: proximity is not evidence of higher activity - the paper's own successful variants sat outside the second shell around the active site.

epiSCI ranks epistatic co-evolutionary support, NOT measured activity. All entries are DOUBLE mutants. In the paper, success was defined as a 1.03-fold or greater titer increase, and no correlation between SCI and measured activity is reported.
In the top 100 pairs the five biggest hub residues take 53 of the 200 position slots: M35 (14 pairs), V351 (13), L165 (9), F204 (9), S22 (8).
Only 8 of the top 100 pairs are shared with the 501-sequence run, and the McBASC scores of the two runs correlate at Spearman 0.227 over the 84,666 pairs both scored.

Of the PH20 positions reported as activity-enhancing in the patent literature (mature 69, 70, 271, 309, 324), this run reaches 271 (best rank 18), 309 (rank 60) and 324 (rank 100), and misses 69 and 70 entirely.
